profile.name: Priya Shah
profile.summary: Product designer with three years of experience in health and consumer apps. I run my own interviews, prototype in Figma, and work closely with engineers until the feature ships. Most proud of work that made complicated forms feel short.

descriptions: Redesigned the patient intake flow from 14 screens to 6, raising completion from 61% to 83% in the first quarter
Ran 22 interviews with clinic staff and turned the findings into a shared research library the team still uses
Built a Figma component library with the front-end lead that cut design-to-build handoff time by about a third
Designed mobile checkout for a regional grocery chain, which lowered abandoned carts by 12% after launch
Led usability tests with 40 participants across five client projects and wrote the findings for each client
Mentored two design interns through their first shipped features
Sketched and tested new bus stop signs with riders at three busy stops, and the agency adopted two of the ideas

educations.degree: Bachelor of Fine Arts in Interaction Design

descriptions: Volunteered to map how visitors get lost and designed floor signs that reduced front desk direction questions by half
Designed and tested a habit app for shift workers, written up as a case study with 4,000 reads on Medium
Design: Figma, ProtoPie, Adobe Illustrator, design systems
Research: Interviews, usability testing, surveys, Dovetail
Collaboration: Jira, Notion, basic HTML and CSS
